brief: A personal mark for the portfolio of a systems developer. It should feel playful and handmade but still technical, match the sticker look of the site, and stay readable as a 16 px favicon.
criteria: Success: unmistakably NW, matches the site's tiles, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, different from the usual terminal-icon developer logos.

concepts.name: Tiles
concepts.idea: Your initials on two tilted letter tiles, the same tiles that drop in on the site.
rationale: Ties the logo directly to the site's hero and Build/Break/Rebuild tiles
Reads as NW at a glance and at 16 px, with a one-letter favicon for the smallest sizes
Hard shadow and thick outline are the site's sticker language, so it reproduces as flat shapes

recommendation: Tiles, final: built as filled paths on one geometry, with a small-size cut, a one-letter favicon, a one-colour version and an on-dark version.
next_steps: Use the favicon and web icons on the site
Use the stacked lockup for the README and social image
Keep the logo guide next to the files
